tools.name: get_active_sessions
tools.title: Active parking
tools.description: Parking sessions running right now. Each sessionInfo[] item has zone {signageCode, internalZoneCode, locationName, zoneInfo}, startLocal, stopLocal (when it expires, in timeZoneStandardName), priceDetail {parkingPrice, billingType}, vehicleLpnState and creditCardType/creditCardLastFourDigits. An empty list means nothing is running. parking_action_type narrows to street/lot sessions (OnDemand) or prepaid reservations (Reservation); omit it for both.

tools.name: get_parking_history
tools.title: Parking history
tools.description: Past parking sessions, newest first. Each sessionInfo[] item has zone {signageCode, locationName}, startLocal, stopLocal, priceDetail {parkingPrice, billingType} and the card used (creditCardType, creditCardLastFourDigits). parking_action_type: OnDemand (street and lot sessions, the default) or Reservation.

tools.name: get_vehicles
tools.title: Vehicles
tools.description: Vehicles on the account: vehicles[] with vehicleId (pass it to start_parking), the plate and its state, and which one is the default. HTTP 404 "Vehicle not found" means the account has no vehicles yet.

tools.name: get_payment_methods
tools.title: Payment methods
tools.description: Saved payment methods in the user's preferred order: billingMethodId (pass it to start_parking) plus card type and masked number only. An empty list means no card is on file.

tools.name: find_zone
tools.title: Look up zone
tools.description: Look up a ParkMobile zone by the number posted on the street sign or meter. The same number can exist in several cities, so check locationName/supplierName. Returns zones[] with internalZoneCode (use it for get_zone_rates and quote_parking), signageCode, locationName, type (OnStreet, Garage...), gpsPoints, parkingActionType and timeZoneStandardName.

zone_number.description: Zone number from the sign, e.g. "51103"

tools.name: find_zones_nearby
tools.title: Zones nearby
tools.description: ParkMobile zones inside a map box, nearest first: zones[] with signageCode, internalZoneCode, locationName, type, distanceMiles and zoneInfo {latitude, longitude}. Geocode an address yourself, then pass a box around it: north = lat + 0.004, south = lat - 0.004, east = lng + 0.005, west = lng - 0.005 (about 500 m). parking_type 1 = pay-by-zone street and lots (default), 2 = reservable garages.

tools.name: get_zone_rates
tools.title: Zone rules
tools.description: Rules for one zone right now: parkInfo.isParkingAllowed and parkingNotAllowedReason, maxParkingTime (longest allowed stay), maxStopTimeLocal (latest end time today), timeBlocks[] (timeblockId, minimumValue/maximumValue/incrementValue in minutes; quote_parking and start_parking need the timeblockId), durationSelections, paymentOptions and isPayBySpace. Use quote_parking for the dollar price.

internal_zone_code.description: internalZoneCode from find_zone or find_zones_nearby, e.g. "71451103"

tools.name: quote_parking
tools.title: Price check
tools.description: Price for parking in a zone for a number of minutes, without buying anything. Returns price[0] {parkingPrice, serviceFee, totalPrice}, currency, parkingStartTimeLocal, parkingStopTimeLocal, isParkingAllowed and parkingNotAllowedReason. Get time_block_id from get_zone_rates (parkInfo.timeBlocks[].timeblockId); minutes must sit between that block's minimumValue and maximumValue (parkInfo.durationSelections lists the steps the app offers, usually 15 minutes).

minutes.description: How long to park, in minutes

tools.name: start_parking
tools.title: Start parking
tools.description: Start a paid parking session. This charges the user's card, so run quote_parking first and get explicit approval with the zone, plate, duration and total. Needs internalZoneCode (find_zone), time_block_id (get_zone_rates), vehicle_id (get_vehicles) and payment_method_id (get_payment_methods billingMethodId).

tools.name: extend_parking
tools.title: Extend parking
tools.description: Add time to a running session. This charges the user's card, so confirm the added minutes and price first. parking_action_id comes from get_active_sessions; time_block_id from get_zone_rates.

parking_action_id.description: Id of the running session from get_active_sessions

playbook: Open https://app.parkmobile.io/login in the in-app browser. Sign in with email or phone: ParkMobile sends a magic link (any app.parkmobile.io URL with ?login_token=); open that link inside the same in-app browser. Google sign-in is blocked in embedded browsers
Wait for GET /api/user to return userProfile (401 while signed out)

provenance.notes: Verified live 2026-11-15 on matt's own account with scripts/re/parkmobile/client.ts (device path, signed-in page): auth.check, get_active_sessions, get_parking_history, get_vehicles (404 Vehicle not found = no vehicles), get_payment_methods, find_zone, find_zones_nearby, get_zone_rates, quote_parking all pass. find_zone, find_zones_nearby, get_zone_rates and quote_parking also pass from plain Node with no session (--cloud). Account had no vehicles, cards or sessions, so list item fields come from the web bundle selectors. start_parking and extend_parking: not executed: charges money (templates lifted from the web bundle startParking/extendParking; X-XSRF-TOKEN acceptance checked on POST /api/refresh only). Session JWT is an HttpOnly cookie, so executor is device.
